lines.x: Seven hours and fifty-nine minutes to go. It's fine, it's fine, don't tense up, act natural, hold on... Huh? Doctor, go ahead! You want me to relax? I'm totally relaxed, hahaha. I'm in the same room as my superiors all the time—they all say I'm very e-efficient. Really.

A c-complaint letter? An Operator's confession to a colleague got sent to a married person by mistake? And the Medical Department's meeting notice brought in ten burdenbeasts?! That was during the last signal calibration—h-how big is the fine? One small cake and an explanation? Sniff... Thank you.

You really don't need me to make you coffee? And you're not going to scold me either? No, I haven't done anything wrong yet—s-so are you going to fire me...? Back then, that was other people bullying me. Of course I know that. I just assumed it would be the same everywhere. We can be different from them, right?

Doctor, could you look through these survey forms for me? They came in two hours ago and I still can't bring myself to—wait! I'm not ready to hear them say my design is completely worthless... The feedback's good? And they even left kind suggestions? Let me see!

Someone took this photo of me while I was climbing the tower, and it ended up in the paper. Thankfully nobody realized it was me... Honestly, thinking back on it still gives me chills—I'm afraid of heights. But since I'll probably never go anywhere that high again in my life, I cut it out and kept it.

The comms towers on Highway Zero are running smoothly, though it hasn't changed my life much. Do I mind? What I gained on that journey matters more than fame. Jacinta, Angelina, and you, Doctor... With everyone's trust, I'll put comms towers up in places even farther away.

I-it's nothing worth looking at! Just some ideas that haven't taken shape yet... I used to think connecting all of Highway Zero by comms was a pipe dream, but now, I suppose I've earned the right to dream a little bigger. What exactly? You'll know on the day it comes true. Hehe.

In the years since I left home, I drifted from place to place, and letters from my family would drift for years without ever reaching my hands. Even knowing there was nothing to be done, the emptiness inside was hard to shake. Looking back, I think I became obsessed with communications technology because my hopes for a reply were dashed, again and again...

My friendship with Angelina and the others began with a lie. They'd rather not bring up the past, for my sake, but I know I shouldn't forget it. Guilt isn't always a negative feeling—it taught me to treasure the people who truly matter. The people who made a drifter like me stop being alone.
Watch a show, listen to music, or build a model kit... If I don't decide soon, my precious break is going to be over—

Hello, Doctor! I'm the new communications engineer. Projects I've worked on include the long-range comms network design in Rim Billiton, the C-Columbian Originium electromagnetic, um, ah—I had it memorized perfectly at home, I've blown it—
The battlefield is so much more complicated than I imagined. I'll have to reset every parameter when I get back... No sleep for me tonight!
"A technical pioneer, diligent and eager to learn"... Doctor, could you write those compliments on the back of my promotion photo? I'd like to mail it home. Hehe.
My next goal is to think about what my work actually means, and not fixate so much on what others think of me. Oh, right, Doctor, what were you about to say about me just now...? I'm so curious—
Technology has to leave the lab eventually. I'll... submit to verification.
I'll keep the signal clear—I won't let everyone's trust down!
Transmitter, receiver, communicator, please watch over me and let it all go smoothly—please!
Hello, everyone. I'll be demonstrating this technical upgrade. Please... bear with me.
Signal received loud and clear, over.
I'm not nervous...
A good design is one that gets built.
Good technology is technology that gets used.
Sorry, sorry, I'll definitely do better next time!
Superconducting electromagnetic launch technology—sorry to trouble you, but do try it!
Originium signal-cutting technology—sorry for the bother, but give it a feel!
...You're the one who kept nitpicking, aren't you? Are you satisfied now? Are you satisfied!
Wahh—do you know how many days I waited for this result?! Praying to the instruments really does work!
I was so nervous just now! I hope the work ahead wraps up just as neatly...
You've worked hard, Doctor. Thank you for your guidance today. Leave the flawed and missing data to me.
This data set is unusable, log complete, preparing to restart the experiment. Surprisingly calm? Me? Not really. A good mindset is something countless failures forge for you.
I'll calibrate as carefully as I can. If there's signal fluctuation, equipment flying about, or small showers of sparks... please talk to me first, don't file a complaint, I'm begging you—
Oh, were you joking with me? Sorry, I didn't catch it—I'll play along next time!
This is... a little invention of mine. If you don't mind, please take it and try it out. I'll come collect your feedback... if that's not too much trouble.
Arknights.

Month-end report, quarter-end report, year-end report, all piled up at once... You too, Doctor? Then... let's put down our pens, stretch out our limbs until our bodies are parallel to the floor, relax the muscles around our eyes, haaa—ah, it's only one day a year. Let's indulge a little...
Doctor...

Happy birthday, Doctor. This—it's not a little bug, it's a signal transmitter with a redesigned shell. I hoped it might help while you're out working... Uh-uh-ah-ah, wait, a fowlbeast just snatched it—sorry, sorry, I'll make you another one right away!

Ever since I was born, it feels like every step forward I took was either forced by circumstance or the result of bad luck. But it's about time I grew up, isn't it? My next step—whatever I choose—I'll take it calmly, firmly, like an adult.
